about: ENMAX (eV) and ZVAL (valence electrons) of the PAW datasets data/dft/potcar_map.json names (H, C, N, O, F: the standard PBE datasets of potpaw_PBE.54/.64; Ti: Ti_pv), for the ENCUT of a relaxation chain written without a POTCAR directory (caps vasp-relax) and the phono3py cost estimate. The POTCAR's own ENMAX and ZVAL are used whenever --pp-dir is given; an element missing here needs --pp-dir (or --encuts).
